title: V1.2.3 local O:NR Mechanic Unlock Card Release 1
preconditions: V1.2.2 Special Zones, Ownership and Control has passed its final gate.
The private local O:NR v1 overlay exists under data/local.
Only the eight listed cards are promoted for V1.2.3.
V1.2.3 cards are human_playable and deck_legal, but not ai_supported.
steps: Start a deterministic game with the V1.2.3 smoke decks and MVP 0.99 baseline mechanics enabled.
Play Overtime Incentives as a Corp operation and verify gainedActions is public without hidden card ids.
Play MIT West Tier as the Runner, shuffle grip/heap/stack, draw cards and move MIT West Tier to Removed from Game.
Replay all events from the initial state.
expected: MIT West Tier is public in Removed from Game.
The MIT West Tier event is a hidden-info barrier and does not expose internal runner card ids.
The AI deck pool remains unchanged and contains no V1.2.3 snapshots.
